statements.subject: server
statements.description: If the transport layer notifies a proxy of an error when it tries to forward a request (see Section 18.4), the proxy MUST behave as if the forwarded request received a 503 (Service Unavailable) response.
actions: treat forwarded request as having received a 503 (Service Unavailable) response

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The proxy SHOULD NOT cancel any outstanding client transactions associated with this response context due to this notification.
statements.pre_cond: transport.error = true & proxy.action = forward_response & proxy.outstanding_client_transactions != empty
actions: retain all outstanding client transactions associated with this response context
